notes:
Top-line: Pebbleline runs a global CCaaS platform for 18k enterprise seats. Looking to add streaming agent-assist (inline suggestions + canned responses) and automatic ticket summarization into their agent desktop. POC goal: demonstrate sub-150ms p95 token latency for streaming suggestions, deterministic tool-calling to their ticketing system, and graceful degradation under 3x baseline traffic (simulate Black Friday).

Key technical asks / quotes: "We need suggestions to feel instantaneous — anything over 200ms is disruptive to agent flow." Wants explicit fallback policy: small local quantized model for bursts, Redwood routing to regional capacity, and audit trail for all generated suggestions.

Integration notes: front-end is React-based agent desktop that connects to their telephony layer via websockets. Tool-calls currently go to Jira and an internal dispatch API; must support an idempotent confirm step before ticket creation.

Security / compliance: must keep transcripts for 30 days in EU region for a subset of customers; enterprise legal asking for KMS-managed keys and proof of SOC2 Type II controls. Data residency question for EU customers — leaning to Redwood Private deployment or Dedicated in EU region.

POC success criteria (agreed):
- Streaming suggestions delivered p95 < 150ms for 1k concurrent agent sessions in pilot environment
- Tool-call flow invoked and audited with retriable semantics and agent confirmation
- Token cost per session < $0.015 (target) after Optimize recommendations
- No false-positive guardrail bypasses in 1k sample transcripts (safety checks pass)

Obstacles: legal wants explicit SLA around deletion/retention; their SSO team needs Help with SAML attribute mapping (email vs uid); finance flagged ARR range — wants clearer committed throughput tiers to budget for Dedicated.

Next steps: SE Ravi to produce stress-test design and quantized-model fallback proposal by 2026-03-17; AE to schedule legal review call week of 2026-03-22.
